If in between sizes, we recommend sizing down. Select a Size Why You'll Love It Meet the Breeze Drift Pant: a redesigned, better-than-ever evolution of our bestselling Breeze Cropped Pant. We kept everything you love about the original—the wildly comfortable knit waistband, the clean tapered-leg silhouette—but went back to the drawing board to fine-tune the features and fit. The result? Performance-level comfort and casual, everyday style that looks great with sneakers, slides, or flip-flops See Fit Guide UPF 50+ Sun Protection 4-Way Stretch Quick-Dry Ultra-Lightweight Construction MATERIALS & CARE Material Description: Ultra-light, stretch woven Material Contents: 86% Polyester / 14% Spandex Fabric Weight (GSM): 127 FEATURES • Ultra-lightweight and airy construction • UPF 50+ offers serious sun protection • 4-way stretch gives you freedom of movement • Quick-dry fabric keeps you cool and comfy • High waist knit waistband with drawstring for customizable comfort • Secure zipper pocket ideal for cash, cards, or keys" SIZE & FIT Elastic waistband Tapered leg Inseam: 26” Measurements based on size Small: - Waist: 28 1/2” - Hip: 39” - Thigh: 24 3/4” - Inseam: 25 1/2” SHIPPING & RETURNS • Free standard shipping on all orders $150+ • Easy 30-day returns and free 60-day exchanges on U.S. orders for unwashed, unworn items. • Final sale styles are not eligible for return or exchange. • Send gifts wrapped by adding on gift wrap at cart. Verified Buyer Rated 5 out of 5 stars 3 weeks ago Reviewing Women's Breeze Drift Pant - Fossil Fossil / S Best pants for fishing, travel, hanging out.... everything!! I love these pants. I am a big fly angler, and I am constantly looking for bottoms to wear while wet-wading. I'm very pale, so I need the UPF protection, but I also get so hot and I'm always climbing over things. These pants have absolutely checked all the boxes for me. They've held up well in all of my shenanigans on the water, they dry very quickly, and they fit so well!. I also like that they have been light weight enough to wear under my waders on cooler mornings, but fit well enough that they aren't bunching up around my calves when I do that. I recently wore these pants to travel on some long-haul flights as well. They were like wearing sweatpants without the bulk. The pockets were big enough to hold my phone and my passport, the pants are flexible enough so I could curl up and nap in the airport. These are probably my fave pants!!
